import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)

class IntList:
    def __init__(self):
        self.data = []
        self.size = 0

    def isEmpty(self):
        return self.size == 0

    def size(self):
        return self.size

    def get(self, index):
        if index < 0 or index >= self.size:
            raise IndexError
        return self.data[index]

    def clear(self):
        self.data.clear()
        self.size = 0

    def set(self, index, value):
        if index < 0 or index >= self.size:
            raise IndexError
        self.data[index] = value

    def expand(self):
        pass

    def insert(self, index, value):
        if index < 0 or index > self.size:
            raise IndexError
        self.data.insert(index, value)
        self.size += 1

    def delete(self, index):
        if index < 0 or index >= self.size:
            raise IndexError
        value = self.data.pop(index)
        self.size -= 1
        return value

    def push(self, value):
        self.data.append(value)
        self.size += 1

    def pop(self):
        if self.size == 0:
            raise IndexError
        value = self.data.pop()
        self.size -= 1
        return value

    def unshift(self, value):
        self.data.insert(0, value)
        self.size += 1

    def shift(self):
        if self.size == 0:
            raise IndexError
        value = self.data.pop(0)
        self.size -= 1
        return value

n = 0
m = 0

def solve(from_, to):
    global n, m
    if from_ + 1 == to:
        res = IntList()
        res.push(from_)
        if from_ + m > n:
            res.push(n - from_)
            res.push(from_ - n)
        res.push(m)
        if from_ > m:
            res.push(n - from_)
            res.push(from_)
        res.push(-from_)
        return res
    else:
        mid = (from_ + to) // 2
        a = solve(from_, mid)
        b = solve(mid, to)
        res = IntList()
        aSize = a.size
        bSize = b.size
        aData = a.data
        bData = b.data
        i = 0
        while True:
            bFrom = 0 if i == 0 else bData[i - 1]
            bTo = n if i == bSize - 1 else bData[i + 1]
            bShift = bData[i]
            aFrom = bFrom + bShift
            aTo = bTo + bShift
            l = 0
            r = aSize - 1
            while l < r:
                m_idx = ((l + r) // 4) * 2 + 1
                if aData[m_idx] <= aFrom:
                    l = m_idx + 1
                else:
                    r = m_idx - 1
            cur = l
            while True:
                res.push(bShift + aData[cur])
                cur += 1
                if cur == aSize:
                    break
                pos = aData[cur]
                if pos >= aTo:
                    break
                res.push(pos - bShift)
                cur += 1
            if i == bSize - 1:
                break
            res.push(bTo)
            i += 2
        return res

def solve_main():
    global n, m
    tokens = iter(sys.stdin.read().split())
    n = int(next(tokens))
    m = int(next(tokens))
    s = int(next(tokens)) - 1
    t = int(next(tokens))
    ct = t % n
    while ct != 0:
        if s < m:
            s += ct
            if s >= n:
                s -= n
        else:
            s -= ct
            if s < 0:
                s += n
        ct -= 1
    cycles = t // n
    if cycles > 0:
        cycleSolve = solve(0, n)
        csSize = cycleSolve.size
        csData = cycleSolve.data
        cycleList = IntList()
        cycleMap = {}
        it = 0
        while it < cycles:
            prev = cycleMap.get(s, -1)
            if prev >= 0:
                s = cycleList.get(prev + (cycles - prev) % (it - prev))
                break
            cycleList.push(s)
            cycleMap[s] = it
            l = 0
            r = csSize - 1
            while l < r:
                m_idx = ((l + r) // 4) * 2 + 1
                if csData[m_idx] <= s:
                    l = m_idx + 1
                else:
                    r = m_idx - 1
            s += csData[l]
            it += 1
    print(s + 1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve_main()
